id: \rLucy: Welcome to the Battle Pike. My name is Lucy.
en: \rLucy: Welcome to the Battle Pike. My name is Lucy.
it: \rLucy: Benvenuto alla Serpe Lotta. Il mio nome è Lucy.

id: \rMost people think that planning or strength are the way to go for battle. While that may be true, you can never underestimate the power of luck.
en: \rMost people think that planning or strength are the way to go for battle. While that may be true, you can never underestimate the power of luck.
it: \rLa maggior parte della gente pensa che strategia o forza siano la chiave per vincere una lotta. Sarà anche vero, ma non bisogna mai sottovalutare il potere della fortuna.

id: \rLet's find out which of us has more.
en: \rLet's find out which of us has more.
it: \rScopriamo chi di noi due ne ha di più.
\rLucy: Ti sei guadagnato il Simbolo Fortuna.

id: \rI suggest the next place you go to is the Battle Palace. It's located on an island near Cinnabar so I would look for a boat there.
en: \rI suggest the next place you go to is the Battle Palace. It's located on an island near Cinnabar so I would look for a boat there.
it: \rTi consiglio di andare al Palazzo Lotta come prossima tappa. Si trova su un'isola vicino a Isola Cannella, quindi cercherei una barca lì.
